messages:
Nina L: Heads-up: prepping 0.30.0 release notes and internal blurb. Canary Monday 07:30 PT, full rollout 08:30 PT. Need rollback owners and deploybot commands.
Omar T: I can own deploy rollback. Priya, can you take DB fallback?
Priya S: Yup, Ill prepare DB revert steps and confirm feature-flag toggles.
Nina L: Draft blurb: "0.30.0 rolling deploy: pins prod to v2.3.0; staging canary v2.4-alpha at 07:30 PT. Full rollout 08:30 PT if green."
Omar T: Add quick commands for ops: staging canary `/deploy start --env staging --version 0.30.0 --canary 5%` and prod `/deploy start --env production --version 0.30.0 --pin v2.3.0`.
deploy-bot: Deploy request queued. Confirm with `/deploy confirm 6001112223` within 10m.
oncall-bot: Oncall ping: @Omar T infra, @Priya S db.
Nina L: Maria (not in thread) will post internal blurb at 08:20 PT and pin until 09:30 PT. Include runbook link and rollback bullets.
Priya S: Rollback bullets ready: abort canary `/deploy abort --env staging`, prod rollback `/deploy rollback --env production --to-version 0.29.9`. Notify #incidents.
Omar T: Monitoring thresholds: abort if error-rate >1.5% or p95 latency +200ms. I'll cut abort and coordinate.
Nina L: Great. I'll trigger confirm once blurb is live.
